coordinator_note: Every theoretical value read against its quotes. Huang 2023 (coreset): the text layer flattens the bounds of Theorems 1 and 2, Lemmas 1 and 2 and Eq. (46), losing square roots and fractions, so each is LOW; Theorem 2's proof is one sentence by analogy. The Section 6.3 compiling result is a null result for coreset, which the Discussion's 'extreme improvements' claim does not reflect; both are entered as the authors say them. Huang 2025 (generative advantage): Theorems 12 and 13 with Conjecture 1 and Proposition 4 are quoted, so the conditional hardness result stays HIGH; the other theorems lose their symbols to private-use characters or are cut, so they are LOW. Huang 2026 (quantum-kernel bandits): the bounds of Theorems 2(ii), 3 and 7 are cut before their formulas; the information-gain bound and the projection lemmas are quoted whole. Hur 2024: Theorem 2.1's conditions are quoted but not its inequality, so it is LOW; Corollary 2.1.1 and the margin-mean bound are quoted with their conditions. Hur's Figure 4 accuracies are entered as ranges only, since the dataset of each figure is not certain from the text layer. Huynh 2024: Theorem 1 is quoted with its assumptions; Theorem 2 is an argument, not a proof. Exponents printed flat are not counted as lost symbols
